summary: Comprehensive testing of coupon/discount system feature. All 23 backend API tests passed. Frontend coupon functionality verified - admin coupons tab works correctly after bug fix, consultation checkout coupon flow works perfectly with FLAT50 coupon showing 50% discount.

bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.issue: CouponsTab was using useAuth((s) => s.token) but useAuth store doesn't have a token property. Token is stored in sessionStorage via rb-admin-session key.
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Changed to read token directly from sessionStorage using getToken() function that parses rb-admin-session JSON
bugs_fixed_by_testing_agent.impact: Admin coupons list was showing 'No coupons created yet' even when coupons existed in database

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all UI tests passed after bug fix)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Coupon feature fully tested. Admin panel Coupons tab (data-testid='coupon-*') has create form and list. FLAT50 coupon exists with 50% discount for courses/lectures/consultations. Consultation checkout has coupon input at data-testid='consult-coupon-input'. Course/lecture checkout modal has coupon input at data-testid='coupon-input' (shown after Google sign-in). Backend APIs: POST /api/admin/coupons (create), GET /api/admin/coupons (list), DELETE /api/admin/coupons/{id}, PATCH /api/admin/coupons/{id}/toggle, POST /api/coupons/validate (public).

admin_coupon_crud.details: Create, list, toggle, delete coupons all working. Duplicate code returns 409.

coupon_validation_api.details: Validates FLAT50 for course/lecture/consultation. Rejects expired, inactive, wrong-kind coupons.

admin_coupons_tab_ui.details: Coupons tab shows create form with all fields and lists existing coupons with toggle/delete buttons.

consultation_checkout_coupon.details: Date picker → Time picker → Form with coupon input. FLAT50 applies 50% discount, shows strikethrough original price.

course_lecture_checkout_coupon.details: Coupon input shown after Google sign-in in checkout modal.

homepage_loads.details: Homepage loads with hero section, courses, lectures sections.

consultation_booking_flow.details: Date picker shows available days (Mon-Sun), time picker shows slots from 2PM-8PM.
